blocks.text: Temperature barhane se reaction ki rate barhti hai. Dekha gaya hai ke har 10 °C izafe par rate dugni ya tigni ho jati hai. Temperature ka rate par aam taur par bara asar hota hai. Zyada temperature par molecules ke paas zyada thermal (garmi wali) energy hoti hai, is liye woh zyada baar aur zyada zor se takrate hain.

Boltzmann distribution curve ek graph hai jo kisi temperature par molecules ki energies ki taqseem (distribution, yani kis ke paas kitni energy) dikhata hai. Kuch particles ki energy bohat kam, kuch ki bohat zyada, aur zyada tar ki darmiyani hoti hai. Yeh graph Figure 7.6 mein hai aur ise Boltzmann distribution kehte hain. Activation energy woh kam se kam energy hai jo takrane wale particles ko product banane ke liye chahiye. Graph ke neeche shaded (rang kiya hua) hissa un molecules ko dikhata hai jin ke paas takra kar chemical tabdeeli lane ki kaafi energy hai. Curve ke neeche poora raqba (area) particles ki kul tadaad hai; shaded hissa Eₐ se zyada energy wale particles ki tadaad hai.

blocks.alt: Boltzmann distribution: molecules ki tadaad banam molecular energy. Curve sifar se shuru ho kar kam energy par choti tak charhta aur lambi dum (tail) mein girta hai. Khari lakeer Ea dikhati hai; Ea se aage dum ke neeche ka raqba jamni rang mein hai, saath likha: 'Ea - is energy aur is se zyada par molecules ke paas mo'assar takrao ki kaafi energy hai'.
blocks.caption: Figure 7.6: Activation energy ke saath molecular energies ki Boltzmann distribution (kitab ki Figure 7.6 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Kitab ki Figure 7.6 ke y-axis par 'Number of molecular' chhapa hai; sahi 'Number of molecules' hai. Curve ke neeche poora raqba tamam molecules hain; Eₐ ke daen jamni hissa woh molecules hain jin ke paas react karne ki kaafi energy hai.

Reaction mixture ka temperature barhayein to particles ki average kinetic (harkat wali) energy barhti hai. Particles tez chalte hain aur zyada baar takrate hain, is liye kaamyab collisions ka hissa bohat barh jata hai (Figure 7.7). Zyada temperature wala Boltzmann curve neecha aur chapta ho jata hai aur us ki choti (peak) daen taraf khisak jati hai. 10 °C izafe par shaded hissa taqreeban dugna ho jata hai. Nateeja: temperature barhane se reaction ki rate barhti hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab yahan 'Figure 7.8' likhti hai; do temperatures wale curves asal mein Figure 7.7 mein hain. Figure 7.8 catalyst wala energy diagram hai (7.3.3).

blocks.alt: Do darja hararat par fraction of collisions banam collision energy, T2 > T1. Neela T1 curve unchi choti wala hai; gulabi T2 curve neecha hai aur us ki choti daen khiski hai ('The peak lowers and shifts to the right'). Narangi nuqta-dar lakeer Ea (activation energy) hai. Ea se aage T1 ke neeche ka raqba gehra neela aur T2 ke neeche ka bara raqba gulabi hai: 'Greater fraction with enough energy to react'.
blocks.caption: Figure 7.7: T1 aur T2 darja hararat par molecular energies ki Boltzmann distribution (kitab ki Figure 7.7 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Neela curve T₁ (kam temperature) aur gulabi curve T₂ (zyada temperature) hai. Eₐ wali line ke daen gulabi hissa neele se kahin bara hai: zyada temperature par zyada molecules ke paas react karne ki kaafi energy hai.

blocks.prompt: a) Boltzmann distribution curve kya hai?
blocks.explanation: Yeh kisi ek temperature par molecules ki tadaad ka un ki energy ke muqable graph hai. Is ka ek ubhar (peak) hai aur zyada energy ki taraf lambi dum (tail). Curve ke neeche ka raqba kul molecules, aur Eₐ se aage wala hissa react kar sakne wale molecules dikhata hai.

blocks.prompt: b) 10 °C izafa reaction ki rate ko taqreeban dugna kyun kar deta hai?
blocks.explanation: 10 °C garam karne se curve daen khisakta aur chapta hota hai, aur Eₐ se aage wala raqba taqreeban dugna ho jata hai. Yani taqreeban dugne molecules ke paas activation energy hoti hai, dugne collisions effective hote hain aur rate taqreeban dugni ho jati hai.

items: Har 10 °C izafe par rate taqreeban dugni ya tigni: molecules tez chalte, zyada baar aur zyada energy se takrate hain.
Boltzmann distribution: Eₐ se aage wala raqba react karne wale molecules hain; temperature barhne par yeh raqba barhta hai.
